title: FIPS gate missing: framework/key_export_public dispatch (read path)
description: src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:477 — crypto2dev_fd_read() for KEY fds calls ops->key_export_public() at line 477 without calling ops->fips_gate() first. The KEY fd read path has no gate call anywhere before the dispatch. crypto2dev_provider.h explicitly lists key_export_public as a gated callback. No current provider implements key_export_public (all NULL), but any provider adding it will run without the gate on every read(2) call on a KEY fd.
